description: Exact misassociated Experience source row retained; actual Bless action candidate pending generic linked-face copy composition.

subrules.name: 702.197a
subrules.rule: Experience is a triggered ability. “Experience” means “Whenever this creature attacks, if it has two or fewer +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it.”

subrules.name: 702.197b
subrules.rule: If a creature with experience has three or more +1/+1 counters on it as the ability tries to resolve, it will have no effect.

behavioral_assertions: When the complete damage trigger resolves legally, its player gets exactly one experience counter before the threshold is evaluated.
Bless action runs only after the player has at least three experience counters.
Target remains player; token copies actual current source back face only if it has Blessing subtype.
Source without a Blessing back face creates no token, even if it copied the front ability.
Token retains Aura/Blessing, enchant player, color/mana/name and devotion-dependent free casting grant.
